s1.div1.p1.fp: I build things that help a body move, or just make moving more fun: an ankle exoskeleton, a full-leg brace, a crutch that carries water, a motorized knee scoote
s1.div1.p1.html: My body has always been held together by chewing gum and dreams. Until recently I was at the mercy of various unexplained muscle strains/ ligament sprains which set a ceiling on my life. I don't like ceilings
s1.div1.p1.name: Paragraph
s1.div1.p1.origHtml: I build things that help a body move, or just make moving more fun: an ankle exoskeleton, a full-leg brace, a crutch that carries water, a motorized knee scooter and a couch that drives. Each one starts as a Fusion 360 model and ends up printed, wired and tested on me.

s10.div1.p1.fp: A small pulley on the motor turns a big one on the wheel, trading speed for torque.
s10.div1.p1.html: With a peak power of over 8Hp and a max speed of 30mph, this medical device is garnered to leave you more injured then you started
s10.div1.p1.name: Paragraph
s10.div1.p1.origHtml: A small pulley on the motor turns a big one on the wheel, trading speed for torque.
